name: barshift
title: BarShift
description: Toggle between or directly choose macOS menu bar visibility modes.
author: 0xAdriaTorralba

commands.name: toggle-menu-bar-auto-hide
commands.title: Toggle Menu Bar Mode
commands.description: Switch between two menu bar visibility modes selected in command preferences.

preferences.name: firstMode
preferences.title: First Mode
preferences.description: The first of the two modes to toggle between.

preferences.name: secondMode
preferences.title: Second Mode
preferences.description: The second of the two modes to toggle between.

commands.name: select-menu-bar-mode
commands.title: Set Menu Bar Mode
commands.description: Choose one of the four macOS menu bar visibility modes.

scripts.build:native: xcrun clang -fobjc-arc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -arch arm64 -arch x86_64 -mmacosx-version-min=13.0 -framework Foundation native/menu-bar-auto-hide-native.m -o assets/menu-bar-auto-hide-native && codesign --force --sign - assets/menu-bar-auto-hide-native
scripts.build: npm run build:native && ray build -e dist
scripts.dev: npm run build:native && ray develop --target x
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'Use npm run publish for the Raycast Store' && exit 1
